content:
leah: seeing intermittent 403s from SCIM deprovisioner in ap-southeast-1 after KMS key rotation last night. Raising here.

ron: example error?

leah: logs: 2026-04-15T11:05:12Z ERROR scim deprov uid=svc-warehouse-9 status=403 reason=KMSDecryptionError AccessDenied

devon: likely policy scoping mismatch after rotation. Which role is assuming the calls?

leah: arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/redwood-scim-provisioner/i-0abc1234. RBAC PR merged this morning tightened key ARNs.

devon: deploying hotfix to add decrypt on the new key ARN to the role. Will record in audit.

security-oncall: mark P2. Track PR author and approver for compliance binder.

deploy-bot: infra/roles@kms-fix started by @devon at 2026-04-15T11:22:40Z

devon: patch applied, please re-run failing deprov if possible.

leah: re-run succeeded: 2026-04-15T11:26:03Z POST /scim/v2/Users/uid=svc-warehouse-9 200 OK. Backfill job queued.

ron: follow-ups: (1) rotation runbook must validate role->key mapping before changing policies, (2) add KMSDecryptError alert to provisioner, (3) consider alias-based policy rather than fixed key ARN.

security-oncall: create SEC-2410 to cover the follow-ups and include smoke decrypt test in rotation steps.

leah: thanks, closing for now once backfill completes. :thumbsup:
